name: ASA GitHub Evidence Audit
purpose: Create traceable evidence for repository activity without reading secrets, overstating current state, or modifying external repositories.

repository_visibility_policy.rule: Every committed byte must be safe for public access. Protected or non-public material must remain outside this repository in a separately approved private environment.
repository_visibility_policy.license_boundary: Public visibility does not grant open-source rights or change copyright ownership.

evidence.verification_rule: Internal Test Only requires a successful GitHub Actions evidence-audit run tied to the relevant commit.

evidence_registry_schema.admissibility_rule: Evidence is admissible for an asserted result only when its source, scope, version, authority, freshness, and integrity reference are known. Missing required fields keep the claim Unverified, Requires Original Source, or Internal Test Only as applicable.

kpi_engine.official_kpi_rule: A metric is not an official KPI until its definition, source, period, baseline where required, owner, eligibility gate, actual value, and evidence reference are all present and the relevant human or institutional gate is satisfied.

p004_human_review_gate.rule: AI pre-review, synthetic closed-set checks, or internal automated mappings do not increment the independent human review count.

risk_engine.hard_gate_rule: A risk that depends on external approval, real-user evidence, independent review, or independent security assessment cannot be marked closed by local tests alone.

audit_event_model.privacy_rule: Audit records should store the minimum data necessary for traceability and must not reproduce secrets, protected organizational content, or unnecessary personal data.

categories.close_internally: Definition, schema, control, test criteria, and evidence requirements can be implemented and verified locally.
categories.collect_real_evidence: Closure requires real measured evidence that cannot be replaced by synthetic or internal simulation.
categories.external_approval_ready: The project may prepare the approval package, but only the authorized external function can close the gate.
categories.hard_gate: Status cannot progress while the required evidence or authorized decision is absent.

gap_closure_engine.production_gate: Production Deployment and Institutional GO remain Not Approved / Not Demonstrated until all applicable hard gates are independently evidenced and the authorized decision is recorded.

prepilot_execution_plan.target_state_rule: The target intermediate state means the project-controlled evidence, measurement methods, risk controls, reviewer package, security readiness material, and governance decision package are complete enough for authorized external review. It does not mean Pilot, Production, Institutional Approval, or Enterprise Readiness.
prepilot_execution_plan.execution_strategy: Run four workstreams in parallel where dependencies allow; do not wait for one external approval before preparing other approval-ready packages.

human_review_design.preferred_distribution: 5 independent reviewers x 10 primary cases, or an equivalent independent distribution approved for the actual review context
human_review_design.quality_control: Use a bounded overlap sample where practical to measure reviewer agreement; disagreements should be adjudicated separately rather than overwritten.
human_review_design.blindness_rule: Where practical, reviewers should not be shown the AI pre-review judgment before recording their own assessment.
human_review_design.dry_run_rule: Synthetic or public-data dry runs may validate the review procedure but do not increment the official independent human review counter.

baseline_design.success_rule: Speed alone is insufficient; interpretation must consider accuracy, evidence quality, and safety together.

user_validation_design.prohibited_interpretation: Do not use this validation to rank, score, or infer employee performance or expertise.

B_data.public_repository_boundary: Protected or organizational corpus content must not be committed to this public-safe repository. Only metadata safe for public disclosure may be stored here; protected evidence requires a separately authorized private environment.

C_security.independence_rule: Project-owned CI, static scans, unit tests, Docker tests, and local security checks may establish readiness and reduce findings but do not count as an independent vulnerability assessment or penetration test.

D_governance.strategy: Prepare one common Pre-Pilot Governance Pack with a shared core and function-specific annexes rather than inconsistent separate narratives.

pilot_candidate_gate.decision_state_when_met: Ready for authorized Pilot Go/Revise/Stop review
pilot_candidate_gate.authority_rule: Meeting technical and evidence gates does not self-authorize a Pilot. The final Go/Revise/Stop decision remains with the authorized institutional decision-makers.

prepilot_execution_plan.anti_overclaim_rule: No local test, AI review, dashboard score, readiness percentage, or project-owner declaration may substitute for independent human evidence or an external institutional approval where that gate requires one.

freshness_rule.rule: Historical records are preserved as evidence of what was true when recorded and must not be silently promoted to current state without a new live verification.

status_gate.evidence_complete_approval_ready_pre_pil: requires completion of all project-controlled preparation and explicit visibility of every remaining external or real-evidence gate; it is not an institutional approval

chatgpt_integration.mode: connected GitHub audit and evidence summarization
chatgpt_integration.write_policy: GitHub mutation requires an explicit current user instruction and must be confirmed by resulting GitHub state. Tool availability is runtime context and must not be stored as a permanent capability claim.
chatgpt_integration.secret_policy: never request, display, or store PAT/API secrets in repository files
